content.value: A moving-coil milliammeter has a resistance of 5Ω and a full-scale deflection of (11) 20mA. Determine the resistance of a shunt to be used so that the instrument could measure currents upto 500mA at $2 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } .$ What is the percentage error in the instrument operating at temperature of $4 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } ?$ Temperature coefficient of copper = 0.0039/°℃.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
